scheme_name: Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme To Dependents Of Crime Victims
other_conditions: Applicant must be native and resident of Kerala.
Applicant must be either the person seriously injured in a crime or a dependent (wife, husband, unmarried son or daughter) of the crime victim.
Application must be submitted within 5 years of the crime.
Beneficiary must execute an agreement with the Department of Social Justice on a ₹200 stamp paper.
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 transferred to the beneficiary’s bank account.
